name: 33972 · Lehigh Acres, FL
findings: ZIP 33972 (Lehigh Acres) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 6 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 3 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33972 (Lehigh Acres) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
